h1: What is the maximum lot coverage in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Lot Coverage Limits by Zoning District
description: Newton's maximum lot coverage percentages for SR1–SR3 and MR1–MR4 from Ord. Sec. 3.1.3 and 3.2.3, by lot creation date.
short_answer: For lots created on or after December 7, 1953, maximum lot coverage is 15% in SR1, 20% in SR2 and 30% in SR3. Older lots allow 20%, 30% and 30%. MR districts allow 30% for detached single- and two-family homes (Ord. Sec. 3.1.3 and 3.2.3).

facts.text: SR1 / SR2 / SR3, lots created on or after 12/7/1953: 15% / 20% / 30%.
SR1 / SR2 / SR3, lots created before 12/7/1953: 20% / 30% / 30%.
MR1–MR4, detached single- or two-family, lots created on or after 12/7/1953: 30% in each district.
MR1–MR3, lots created before 12/7/1953: 30%. The table gives no MR4 value for these older lots.

qa.q: What is the lot coverage limit in SR2?
qa.a: 20% for lots created on or after December 7, 1953, and 30% for older lots (Sec. 3.1.3).

qa.q: Is lot coverage the same as FAR?
qa.a: No. FAR is a separate limit: gross floor area of all buildings divided by lot area (Sec. 1.5.5.A.1).

qa.q: What is the limit in MR districts?
qa.a: 30% for detached single- and two-family homes (Sec. 3.2.3).
